title: The Guilty Look Isn't Guilt
description:
A dog's guilty look is influenced by owner cues and scolding, not by whether the dog actually disobeyed.

Read the situation and the dog's behavior instead of treating the look as a confession.

Sources:
- Horowitz, A. (2009). Disambiguating the 'guilty look': salient prompts to a familiar dog behaviour. Behavioural Processes 81(3), 447-452. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.beproc.2009.03.014
